canonical_resolution: RFC-003 §9.1 and §11 item 16 record per-target proposal and approval binding with declared interdependence
rationale: Canonical text directly answers both branches
trigger: Material change to RFC-003 §9.1 or cited ADR-DEV-007/ADR-002-023
scope_restriction: No aggregated authority

deferred_artifact: ADR-002-016 plus ADR-DEV-002 Evidence Granularity amendment
rationale: The evidence and artifact-identity owners must define a reconstructable minimum without granting authority
trigger: Before accepting either ADR or admitting a decision artifact
scope_restriction: Decision artifacts without the approved minimum are inadmissible

canonical_resolution: RFC-003 §10 makes determining non-recomputable values non-approvable and permits only soft non-determining evidence
rationale: The determining-value rule is resolved; market-specific classification remains a separate RFC-004 profile question
trigger: Material change to RFC-003 §10 or SAFE-034
scope_restriction: Relabeling cannot avoid Critical Input treatment

canonical_resolution: RFC-003 §9.1 distinguishes hold from an explicit reduction proposal
rationale: Canonical text directly answers the question
trigger: Material change to RFC-003 §9.1 or ADR-DEV-007
scope_restriction: No-action cannot encode a reduction

question_summary: Concrete companion models and expectancy realism
deferred_artifact: Economic Viability Profile plus Market Risk Execution and Hedge Profiles
rationale: Human-owned profiles must bind the concrete models and the ECO evidence family without inventing bounds
trigger: Before any CONST-003 completion or strategy admission claim
scope_restriction: No strategy completes CONST-003 while any required profile or ECO evidence is incomplete

question_summary: Decision with degraded or unavailable companion model
rationale: ADR-DEV-008 already owns restrictive degraded-companion semantics
trigger: Before accepting ADR-DEV-008 or enabling a degraded companion path
scope_restriction: Unknown or unavailable companion state yields no new authority

rationale: Regime taxonomy and approved features are scope-specific human-owned model choices
trigger: Before a regime label can determine an admitted decision input
scope_restriction: Unprofiled regime is UNKNOWN and non-determining

question_summary: Shared versus decoupled volatility and correlation estimates
accountable_owner: Market Model Owner plus Risk Model Owner
rationale: Common-mode and intentional-decoupling treatment needs an explicit jointly owned profile
trigger: Before either estimate can affect risk sizing or regime admission
scope_restriction: No benefit from agreement or divergence until profile-bound

question_summary: VI halt or price-limit state representation
deferred_artifact: Market Context Continuity Profile plus ADR-002-018 and ADR-002-019
rationale: Acquisition continuity and venue-state admission belong upstream of the decision model
trigger: Before the first VI or price-limit affected input is admitted
scope_restriction: Affected scope cannot create new risk while state is missing stale or contradictory

question_summary: Mini versus full KOSPI200 product model
rationale: Multiplier tick and product identity must be versioned instead of chosen by convention
trigger: Before either product feeds a determining model
scope_restriction: Unsupported product or unbound parameters are inadmissible

question_summary: KRX rule-set version pin and refresh trigger
rationale: Rule provenance currency and invalidation require an accountable source profile
trigger: Before venue constraints are admitted and whenever source revision is detected
scope_restriction: Stale or unpinned rules restrict affected scope

question_summary: Impact boundary between market property and execution realization
accountable_owner: Execution Model Owner plus Market Model Owner
rationale: A shared versioned schema must prevent inconsistent impact assumptions without prescribing tactics in RFC-004
trigger: Before impact enters expectancy or order planning
scope_restriction: No cross-model impact benefit is recognized without a common profile

rationale: The realizable algorithm is broker and scope dependent and cannot be selected informally
trigger: Before an execution planner is admitted
scope_restriction: No unprofiled tactic may transmit or claim benchmark quality

accountable_owner: Investment Authority plus Execution Model Owner
rationale: Benchmark selection is an investment-evaluation decision and may differ only by an approved scope binding
trigger: Before performance attribution or ECO evidence
scope_restriction: No benchmark-relative PASS without the approved profile

question_summary: Temporary and permanent impact with limited depth
rationale: Estimation method and uncertainty need data-coverage and model-error declarations
trigger: Before impact benefit or cost is used in sizing or ECO evidence
scope_restriction: Unknown impact is conservative and cannot improve expectancy

rationale: Call auction has distinct venue and fill semantics that require a scoped profile
trigger: Before any call-auction order path is admitted
scope_restriction: Call-auction participation is disabled outside an approved profile

deferred_artifact: ADR-002-002 plus ADR-002-022 plus Broker Capability Profile
rationale: Existing Proposed safety ADRs and broker capability facts own identity reconciliation and action-flow preconditions
trigger: Before any retry after UNKNOWN is enabled
scope_restriction: UNKNOWN forbids blind retry and retains capacity

deferred_artifact: Execution Cost and Impact Profile plus Economic Viability Profile
accountable_owner: Execution Model Owner plus Investment Authority
rationale: One version binding is required to prevent backtest runtime and evaluation cost drift
trigger: Before ECO evidence can leave NOT_IMPLEMENTED
scope_restriction: Inconsistent or unbound cost models make the result INCONCLUSIVE

question_summary: VaR or ES estimation method by scope
rationale: Estimator selection and model-risk bounds are human-owned and product/account specific
trigger: Before any measure can set a risk bound
scope_restriction: Unprofiled estimates cannot grant capacity or authority

rationale: Measure precedence changes interpretation and must be explicitly approved
trigger: Before risk measures determine sizing limits or admission
scope_restriction: Conflicting measures resolve conservatively

question_summary: Shared versus decoupled market and risk estimates
accountable_owner: Market Model Owner plus Risk Authority
rationale: The common-mode and decoupling policy is jointly owned
trigger: Before volatility or correlation affects sizing
scope_restriction: No diversification or stability benefit without profile proof

rationale: Investment allocation and risk-capacity authorization are different decisions and need explicit ownership
trigger: Before cross-asset capital allocation
scope_restriction: No cross-asset netting or capital transfer is authorized

rationale: Drawdown magnitude duration and recovery policy affect economics and risk independently of consecutive-loss rules
trigger: Before drawdown state can alter sizing or retirement
scope_restriction: Missing profile restricts new risk and cannot auto-retire or auto-promote

accountable_owner: Investment Authority plus independent evidence reviewer
rationale: A dedicated economic family is required because RLP trial governance does not prove expectancy
trigger: Before any CONST-003 completion claim
scope_restriction: RLP PASS without ECO completion remains CONST-003 INCOMPLETE

question_summary: Benefit-recognition proofs and unsupported broker/product scopes
rationale: Netting hedge and correlation benefit need explicit proofs and capability scope
trigger: Before any benefit reduces worst-credible risk
scope_restriction: Unproven benefit is zero and unsupported scope remains non-live

accountable_owner: Investment Authority plus Hedge Model Owner
rationale: Method window and regime treatment determine investment economics and need an approved version
trigger: Before hedge benefit is recognized
scope_restriction: Unprofiled hedge ratio grants no benefit

question_summary: Mini or full product sizing rounding and basis
accountable_owner: Hedge Model Owner plus Risk Authority
rationale: Product multiplier rounding and residual basis must be explicit and capability-bound
trigger: Before hedge orders or benefit recognition
scope_restriction: Residual basis is counted conservatively

accountable_owner: Hedge Model Owner plus Execution Model Owner
rationale: Roll timing overlap and liquidity create separate risk and execution obligations
trigger: Before any automated roll path is enabled
scope_restriction: Roll is operator-gated or disabled without an approved profile

deferred_artifact: Investment Mandate and Allocation Profile plus Hedge Model Profile
rationale: Proxy choice and re-estimation frequency are mandate decisions and determine claimed hedge benefit
trigger: Before portfolio beta informs capital or hedge sizing
scope_restriction: No proxy-based benefit without mandate binding

rationale: Residual-risk acceptance or compensating control is a human authority act
trigger: Before overnight risk is admitted
scope_restriction: Overnight exposure stays within the currently narrower approved scope

question_summary: Hedge benefit-recognition proof and unsupported books
rationale: Correlation and basis benefit must survive worst-credible proof by book composition
trigger: Before any hedge benefit reduces aggregate risk
scope_restriction: Unproven benefit is zero and unsupported compositions are non-protective
